shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
git log --oneline -5
rg -n \"class ToolRegistry|execute\\(|inputSchema|registry\" src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md 2>/dev/null || true
rg --files | rg 'registry|spec|package.json|prettier|test-commands' | head -80"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true
sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
sed -n '1,180p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
cat package.json | sed -n '1,120p'
rg -n \"defensive|cast|missing input|inputSchema|registry|schema|validation|malformed|executor|tool result|tool-round|extra propert|rejection\" README.md docs/adding-a-tool.md .specify/spec.md adrs/ADR-002-response-validation.md CHANGELOG.md example/weather-tool.ts 2>/dev/null | head -220
rg -n \"validated by|specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation\" src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"\\[validated by(:)? .*registry\\.test\\.ts|reports a wrong-typed property\" specs src | head -40
sed -n '1,120p' scripts/check-spec-links.mjs
rg -n \"require-spec-link|validated by\" eslint.config* scripts src | head -80"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git diff --check
git diff -- specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git commit -m "Fix schema validation test traceability" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
